records.definition: A holder has a motivational orientation toward the obtaining of the specified propositional content. The content is desired rather than asserted as actual. Desire does not entail a plan, intention, action, permission, pleasant feeling, objective benefit, achievable outcome or persistence across cognitive episodes, and need not be presently conscious or attended to.
excludes: A dependency, attention relation or pleasant feeling alone
Actuality of the desired content or an intended action inferred from desire
A bare object without its contextually intended desired relation

records.definition: A holder favors the target alternative over the comparison-standard alternative in the contextual respect. Both alternatives and their direction belong to this one comparison. This does not entail wanting either alternative absolutely, pleasantness, actual selection, objective superiority, explicit deliberation, present attention, persistence across cognitive episodes, or a complete or transitive ordering of other alternatives. Alternatives can denote individuals, kinds or propositions without asserting that hypothetical content obtains.
excludes: Positive feeling or care used as preference
Choice, objective goodness or desire for both alternatives inferred from relative preference
